cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded card with Freecharge that rewards mobile recharges, bill payments, and wallet spends with cashback and discounts, making it ideal for digital-first users.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: 15% off up to INR 500 on EazyDiner.|Minimum Order Value INR 2500
benefitRows.howToAvail: Select the restaurant to be paid on the EazyDiner app.|Enter the amount, and select the offer.|Discount will be applied and net payment will be required to be made.

benefitRows.name: Eros Now
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Freecharge app or website and sign up for Eros Now membership using your Axis Freecharge credit card. Apply applicable promo codes during subscription to redeem complimentary or discounted Eros Now membership. Contact Axis Bank customer care at 1860 419 5555 for help.
